snippet.description:
Git Fundamentals Guide in 10 Seconds!🔥 Git Commands Made Easy for Beginners, Developers & 100DaysOfCode

We break down the Git Fundamentals every software developer, engineer, programmer, and web developer should know. 
Whether you’re a beginner, codenewbie, or on your #100DaysOfCode challenge, mastering Git is essential for version control and collaborative coding.

🔑 What You’ll Learn in This Short:
- Git Basics: Version control system, branching, distributed architecture, open-source benefits.
- Core Git Concepts: Working directory, staging area, local repository, and remote repositories.

Essential Git Commands:
git config (setup name & email)
git init (initialize repository)
git clone (clone repository)

Basic Operations: git status, git add, git commit, git log, git diff.
Branching & Merging: Create, switch, merge, and delete branches.
Remote Operations: Push, pull, fetch, clone, rebase, set upstream.

Workflow Overview: From working directory ➝ staging ➝ local repo ➝ remote repo.

Software Developers & Engineers
Programmers & Web Developers
Beginners & CodeNewbies

Git is the backbone of modern software development, used by teams worldwide on GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. It helps you track changes, collaborate effectively, and manage projects like a pro.

snippet.title: I Built a $1M/y SaaS with Claude Code, Here's How
snippet.description:
💎 Check out Clairvo & 2x your rev: https://clairvo.io/
🔥 Join Maker School & get customer #1 guaranteed: https://skool.com/makerschool/about
➡️ If this is your first video: I'm Nick Saraev. I run LeftClick, an AI growth consultancy. We've done work for large brands you're likely familiar with, like Mr. Beast, Anthropic, OpenAI, and a few others.

In plain English: I help people build systems that generate leads, close deals, and scale businesses, mostly using new AI models like Claude. I also make videos about how to do all of that here on YouTube.

It hasn't always been this way. My family immigrated from a Soviet bloc country (People's Republic of Bulgaria) in the 90s. They worked extremely hard, and we were broke for a very long time. I grew up wishing for more security, stability, and freedom over my own life.

I don't have a programming degree, and never took formal education for IT or workflows. I learned it all myself from YouTube videos like you're watching now.

As for my path: I started my first business at 19 in college. We threw events (mostly parties) at campus bars, and charged people for entry. 

That failed to provide me enough money to pay my bills, so at 21, I started another business, a door-to-door marketing agency.

From there, every year, I would start several companies, over 10 in total. I did this in a variety of industries, like e-commerce, photography, videography, SaaS, credit repair, etc. Each grew slightly more profitable, until, at 25, I would start 1SecondCopy, a content writing company. A friend and I eventually scaled that to over $90,000/m. It was my first taste of financial independence, and the reason I'm here today.

snippet.title: 9 Unsexy Habits That Will Put You Ahead of 99% of People
snippet.description:
Subscribe to my newsletter → https://www.sandeepswadia.com/newsletter 

Most people think big goals create big results.
Ironically, research suggests the opposite.

After studying people for over 20 years, New York University researchers found that vividly imagining success can actually make you less likely to achieve it. Why? Because your brain gets rewarded for the fantasy before you've done the work.

In this episode, I break down why meaningful change rarely comes from motivation, vision boards, or ambitious goals—and why it almost always comes from small, boring habits that quietly reshape your attention, energy, and happiness.

You'll learn how to:

• Break overwhelming goals into tiny actions that actually get done
• Recover quickly when you fall into bad habits instead of spiraling
• Eliminate mental clutter and regain control of your attention
• Use writing as a tool for clearer thinking and better decisions
• Work with your brain's natural energy cycles instead of fighting them
• Improve sleep quality by understanding how caffeine really affects you
• Build habits that survive bad days, low motivation, and setbacks
• Create more gratitude, perspective, and resilience in everyday life
• Develop systems that continue working long after motivation disappears

I also share lessons from a Mount Everest climber, insights from neuroscience, sleep research, quantum physics, Amazon's decision-making culture, and practical ideas from thinkers like James Clear, Andrew Huberman, Jeff Bezos, and Max Planck.

Most importantly, you'll learn why lasting transformation is rarely about becoming a different person.

It's about becoming the kind of person who consistently takes the next step.

Because success is not built on extraordinary moments.

It's built on ordinary actions repeated long enough to become who you are.
